full_judgment: 38. We have already found that in purchasing 7(seven) Kathas of land from Basundhara Group of Companies appellant No. 1 was not involved in any way. None of the PWs 11-16 identified the handwriting of the Chairman of Basundhara Group of Companies inasmuch as the prosecution could not explain as to why the Chairman was not examined and, as such, non-production of the best evidence available would lead a reasonable presumption under section 114(g) of the evidence Act in favour of the convict-appellants. Thus, it was also not proved beyond reasonable doubts that appellant No. 1 acquired the landed property from Basundhara Group of Companies in the name of appellant No. 2 without any consideration.
